Subquery

A subquery defines a row set within an SQL statement.

Syntax
<subquery>
    ::= <query expression>​
Examples

Example 1: The following query calculates the maximum salary of all employees. 

SELECT MAX( salary )
FROM dbtst120

Example 2: The following query calculates the average salary of all employees with the same education level as the 'current' employee. Because the subquery contains an outer column reference it is called a correlated subquery. 

SELECT AVG( salary )
FROM dbtst120
WHERE edlevel = employee.edlevel
